name: quay
description: quay: a provider-agnostic task board (Core CLI/MCP client + pluggable Provider ABI). This plugin bundles the quay MCP server, the quay-native author/execute authoring skills, and a workspace-portable quay-directive skill so any project can install quay's task tools + authoring methodology in one step.

plugins.name: quay
plugins.description: quay MCP server (task_list/task_get/task_write/task_check/action_list/action_run over whichever Provider the target workspace's .quay/config.yml enables) + quay-native author/execute authoring skills + a workspace-portable quay-directive skill (ships its own schema-check, no experiments/ dir required).
